views.prompt: Full-body character reference for 3D modelling of a 23-year-old Japanese diner waitress living in a Russian seaside town: petite, black chin-length bob with straight bangs, no makeup; a short-sleeved white work shirt, a long dark red bib apron to the knees tied at the waist, black straight trousers, black canvas sneakers. Strict T-pose: standing straight, arms stretched out horizontally to the sides at shoulder height, elbows straight, palms facing down, fingers together, feet shoulder width apart, flat on the floor. Neutral calm expression, mouth closed, eyes open. Whole body visible from the top of the hair to the soles of the shoes, centred, nothing cropped. Orthographic-looking views, camera at chest height. Plain light grey seamless studio background, soft even shadowless lighting, no props, no bag, no text, photorealistic, realistic body proportions.
